title: Binary Cube Encryption Laboratory Tool Projection
description: Portable structured-tool projection for the Binary Cube laboratory. It describes calls into the canonical adapter/engine and does not implement encryption logic or provide a remote RPC service.

protocolMappings.openaiFunctionTools: Expose each entry in tools as a function tool using its name, description, and inputSchema; bind execution to the named adapter method.
protocolMappings.mcp: Expose each entry in tools as an MCP tool using inputSchema; bind execution locally to the named adapter method. This descriptor is not itself an MCP server.
protocolMappings.genericJsonTool: Use the tool name and inputSchema, then dispatch to binding.method on binary-cube-node-adapter.js.

tools.name: binary_cube_describe
tools.description: Describe the Binary Cube laboratory, runtime, security classification, discovery facilities, and callable operation names.

tools.name: binary_cube_list_operations
tools.description: List every callable Binary Cube operation together with its canonical positional arguments and return contract.

tools.name: binary_cube_operation_contract
tools.description: Return the canonical argument and return contract for one Binary Cube operation before constructing an invocation.

tools.name: binary_cube_invoke
tools.description: Invoke one documented Binary Cube operation through the canonical adapter. Retrieve its operation contract first when positional arguments are not already known.

args.description: Positional arguments in the exact order declared by binary_cube_operation_contract / api/operation-contracts.json.

tools.name: binary_cube_self_test
tools.description: Run the deterministic Binary Cube portable acceptance tests in the current Node/CommonJS host and return structured pass/fail evidence.

adoption.notes: Hosts should not claim readiness until binary_cube_self_test succeeds in that host.
